name: chromaprint
description: Acoustic fingerprinting library and CLI (AcoustID) for content-based audio identification and duplicate detection

fpcalc.description: Computes a Chromaprint acoustic fingerprint from an audio file; fingerprints are stable across bitrate and codec, so they match the same sound across different encodings
fpcalc.usage:
fpcalc song.ogg # Print DURATION and FINGERPRINT
fpcalc -raw sound.ogg # Emit the raw integer fingerprint (for programmatic compare)
fpcalc -json *.ogg # JSON output for batch tooling
fpcalc -length 30 clip.wav # Fingerprint only the first 30 seconds
